subtasks.goal:
Add ASCII slug normalization using named ESM exports.
Missing src/slug.mjs → create exported function slugify(text), returning text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').
src/index.mjs version-only export → preserve export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
Keep test/slug.test.mjs and all other existing files unchanged; no dependencies or input coercion.
